---
title: "AI feedback for learning"
---

One Quarto extension for feedback on text, translations, images, mathematics
and Python. Activities supply their task and learner response; the extension
handles provider settings, prompts and feedback display.

[Try the working examples](examples.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

The examples start in **Copy prompt** mode. Enter a response and click
**Feedback**, then paste the generated prompt into your preferred AI chat.
You can also use **Feedback settings** to enter your own API endpoint, model
and personal key for replies directly on the page.

Your institution supplies the API base URL and model. The extension bundles
no provider presets. For images in copy mode, attach the original files in
your chat as well.

These examples grow as each exercise integration migrates. A feature is added
to this page only with a working example and automated checks.
